notes: Evidence is only a generic country-selector page; most facets rely on general knowledge of MSA Safety.

instrument_device_family.value: Safety products: fixed gas and flame detection, portable gas detectors, SCBA breathing apparatus, head and fall protection, firefighter helmets

clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Industrial worker safety, fire service, oil and gas, utilities, construction and facility infrastructure protection

product_specific_regulatory_status.value: Nonmedical safety equipment; products carry safety certifications such as NIOSH, ATEX and NFPA, not FDA device clearance

consumables_service_attachment.value: Equipment sales with recurring aftermarket: replacement sensors, filters, parts, service and connected-software subscriptions

calibration_qualification_requirement.value: Gas detectors need regular calibration and bump testing; breathing apparatus needs periodic inspection and service
